config.install_script:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
mkdir -p /workspace/tools/godot-4.7.2 /workspace/.config /workspace/.local/share /workspace/.cache
cd /workspace/tools/godot-4.7.2
curl -fsSL https://github.com/godotengine/godot/releases/download/4.7.2-stable/Godot_v4.7.2-stable_linux.x86_64.zip -o godot.zip
curl -fsSL https://github.com/godotengine/godot/releases/download/4.7.2-stable/SHA512-SUMS.txt -o SHA512-SUMS.txt
python3 - <<'PY'
import hashlib,pathlib,zipfile
p=pathlib.Path('.')
n='Godot_v4.7.2-stable_linux.x86_64.zip'
line=next(s for s in (p/'SHA512-SUMS.txt').read_text().splitlines() if s.split()[-1].lstrip('*')==n)
assert hashlib.sha512((p/'godot.zip').read_bytes()).hexdigest()==line.split()[0], 'SHA512 mismatch'
with zipfile.ZipFile(p/'godot.zip') as z:z.extractall(p)
(p/n.removesuffix('.zip')).chmod(0o755)
PY
export XDG_CONFIG_HOME=/workspace/.config XDG_DATA_HOME=/workspace/.local/share XDG_CACHE_HOME=/workspace/.cache
export UV_OFFLINE=1 UV_PYTHON_DOWNLOADS=never GODOT_AI_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=true
./Godot_v4.7.2-stable_linux.x86_64 --version
./Godot_v4.7.2-stable_linux.x86_64 --headless --editor --path /workspace/Metro/Game --import
config.start_skill: Project: /workspace/Metro/Game. Import and run Godot 4.7.2 with --path /workspace/Metro/Game. Run python3 /workspace/Metro/test/tools/run_tests.py --godot /workspace/tools/godot-4.7.2/Godot_v4.7.2-stable_linux.x86_64. Optional authoring UI: python3 /workspace/Metro/tools/editors/server.py --port 8765 --no-browser. Preserve existing environment variables, repositories, secret and network settings.
